Once dinner is over, there is nothing left but bathing and bed.

There is no problem.

This is so utterly ordinary that there cannot possibly be any problem at all.

…No. I had noticed long before she said anything.

I watched Sakura grow steadily more beautiful through the years of adolescence.

I felt proud of her, as though it were my own accomplishment, and at the same time commanded myself never to become conscious of it.

Sakura is Shinji’s sister. She began looking after me only because she felt responsible for what Shinji had done.

……その後、たしか桜の方から怪我が治るまでお手伝いします、なんて言いだしたんだっけ。

pages.en:
“…It has been a year and a half already. Sakura never needed to feel responsible.”

The accident that led me to leave the archery club.

I injured my shoulder at work. The subject of my burn scar arose, and I decided it was as good an occasion as any to resign from the club.

…Afterward, Sakura offered to help me until the injury healed. Yes, I think that was how it happened.

pages.ja:
あの頃はまだ幼さが残っていて、とにかく一生懸命な子だった。
うちの前で俺の帰りをずっと待っていて、顔を合わしたら合わしたでこれまたずっと黙り込んでしまって、手伝いをしたい、って一言が出るまで二時間もかかったぐらいだ。

She still had a childish air then and threw herself earnestly into everything.

She waited outside my house until I returned, then fell silent the moment she saw me. It took her two full hours to force out the words *I want to help.*

pages.ja:
「
あの引っ込み思案な桜が、いまじゃ弓道部の期待の星だもんな。人間、変われば変わるもんだ」

pages.en: “—And now that painfully shy Sakura is the archery club’s great hope. People really can change.”

pages.ja:
実際、桜は明るくなった。
初めて会ったのは四年前だ。慎二と知り合って、あいつの家に遊びにいった時だったっけ。

pages.en:
Sakura truly has grown brighter.

We first met four years ago, after I became friends with Shinji and went to visit his house.

pages.ja:
桜は無口で、顔を髪で隠すクセがあった。
……それは今でも残っているけど、当時の桜は本当に元気がなかった。いつも暗い目をして、ぼんやりと佇んでいるだけだったのだ。
それを思うと、今の桜を見るのは純粋に嬉しい。
元気のない顔で地面を見つめていた女の子が、楽しそうに笑っているだけでホッとする。

pages.en:
Sakura hardly spoke and had a habit of hiding her face behind her hair.

…Some of that remains even now, but in those days she seemed utterly lifeless. Her eyes were always dark, and she did nothing but stand in a daze.

Remembering that, the person she has become fills me with unalloyed happiness.

It is enough to see the girl who once stared miserably at the ground smiling with joy.

pages.ja: “そう思う事はないの？ 桜の体は柔らかそうだなー、とか、抱きしめたいなー、とか”

pages.en: *“Don’t you ever think of her that way? That Sakura looks soft, or that you want to hold her?”*

少なくともつい最近まで、桜は純粋に後輩だった。
それが微妙に崩れ始めたのはつい最近だ。
……変化はここ最近からなのか、気付かないだけでずっと前からそうだったのか。
それとも。
気付く必要なんてないぐらい、身近な存在だったのか。

“————”

…I do not understand my own feelings.

Until very recently, Sakura was simply my junior.

That certainty began to give way only a short while ago.

…Did something change in these last few days? Or had it always been changing, while I alone failed to notice?

—Or perhaps

she was always too close to me for the distinction to be necessary.

桜が泊まるって事だけで胸がおかしくなるのか。
こんなんじゃ桜にも失礼だ。
さっさと部屋の掃除を済ませて、桜を部屋に案内しよう

“…Damn it. We’ve lived peacefully all this time, so why does this have to—”

Why should the mere fact that Sakura is staying here make my heart behave this way?

It is disrespectful to her.

I need to finish preparing the room and show Sakura inside—

「あれ？ セイバー、桜は？」
「さあ。こちらには来ていませんから、まだ入浴しているのではないですか？」
「……？ 入浴中って、もう一時間は経ってるよな」

pages.en:
“What? Saber, where’s Sakura?”

“I cannot say. She has not come here, so I assume she is still bathing.”

“…? But she went in almost an hour ago.”

pages.ja:

俺とは違って洗うところも多そうだし、カラスの行水ってワケにもいかな

pages.en:
…Perhaps Sakura simply takes long baths.

Unlike me, she has rather more to wash, and she can hardly be expected to dart through like a crow skimming the water—

“——Enough! Stop it…! No more strange imaginings!”

I shake my head and take a place at the table.

Then I pour tea and swallow it in a single torrent.

“—Whew.”

I banish the fantasy and breathe out.

Then—

“Shirou. Is Sakura’s eyesight poor?”

Saber asks the peculiar question.

“? No, not at all. Sakura has excellent eyesight.

“Together, her eyes must be at least 1.5.”

“I see. She strikes walls and pillars with some frequency, so I feared she might have difficulty seeing.”

pages.en: “Oh, I see. …I appreciate your concern, but Sakura is perfectly healthy. She’s only been exhausted lately. Usually, she’s more dependable than I am.”
